title: Remulla suspects pilot used coffins to smuggle drugs into Philippines

blocks.text: Authorities suspect that pilot Rioklyn “Boyet” Toledo may have previously smuggled illegal drugs into the Philippines by hiding them inside coffins transported through his air ambulance service, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said Monday.
